content.description: Hammer of the Scots is a block wargame. Your forces are wooden blocks that stand upright facing you, so your opponent cannot see a unit's type or strength until it fights. These three short animations show the core ideas.
A block stands so only its owner sees the strength on the top edge. The enemy just sees a blank back. When the block is committed to battle it is stood face-up for both players to see.

action.caption: A block hides its strength until it is revealed

hint.description: Tap Replay to watch a block reveal its strength.

content.description: When a block takes a hit in combat it is rotated down one step to show one less strength. It stays in the fight, just weaker. A block reduced to zero is eliminated.

action.caption: A hit reduces a block by one step

hint.description: Watch a hit drop this block from strength 3 to 2.

content.description: Blocks move between connected areas. When blocks of both sides end up in the same area, a battle begins and both sides reveal and fight.

action.caption: Moving across the boundary into an occupied area forces a battle

hint.description: A Scottish block advances into an area held by an English block.

beats.label: Two areas, divided by a boundary

content.description: Hidden strength, losing a step on a hit, and moving blocks to force battles are the heart of every block wargame. The rest of Hammer of the Scots is the year-by-year card play and the fight to control the Scottish nobles. Keep the rulebook handy for the full sequence of play.
